caption: Real screenshot. Ranked by how much each thing actually moved it, which means the boring one is first and the supplements are near the bottom.
notes: The screenshot is the post; everything after is the explanation.

slides.text: my resting heart rate is 39 and it's mostly not the thing you think it is
slides.sub: ranked by what actually moved it…

slides.caption: Oura, week of Aug 16 to 22. Range 37 to 45. Eight runs that week.

slides.sub: Most of them slow enough to hold a conversation. This is most of the answer.
One drink is worth about 3 to 5 bpm on my own numbers.
Same bedtime within half an hour. Regularity beat total hours.

slides.text: Magnesium does nothing I can see here.
slides.sub: It gets me to sleep faster. It does not show up in this number.

slides.text: And the part I didn't earn.
slides.sub: Years of aerobic base, and being young. Two people doing all of this land in different places.

slides.text: Don't copy my list. Test one line of it on you.
slides.sub: That's the whole idea behind Ren. It takes your Oura or Apple Health data, runs one change at a time, and tells you after two weeks whether it actually did anything.
